name: Team Squirtle: Sevii Tides Vanguard
archetype: Sevii archipelago & Jasmine duel core — Electric speed sweeping, 4x Ice execution, 4x Fighting breaking, Flying Ground immunity, and Intimidate Attack reduction.
gym_duel_rationale: For Jasmine's 5 vs 5 duel on Bond Bridge, Slots 1 through 5 take the field: Jolteon/Sandslash (Slot 2) acts as Jasmine's primary counter, zapping Skarmory/Dodrio and Magnezone/Blastoise with STAB Discharge and crushing Mawile/Rhydon with Earthquake; Lapras (Slot 3) absorbs water attacks with Water Absorb and vaporizes Altaria/Steelix with 4x STAB Ice Beam; Blastoise/Fearow (Slot 1) resists Ground via Flying typing and strikes Scizor/Cacturne with STAB Drill Peck; Arbok/Primeape (Slot 4) provides Intimidate to defang physical attackers and punches through Mawile/Rhydon with 4x Close Combat; and Alakazam/Weezing (Slot 5) floats above Earthquakes with Levitate and supports with Calm Mind. Snorlax rests in reserve as the route endurance tank.

roster.progression_notes: 486 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 76. Flying typing grants complete immunity to Jasmine's Earthquakes. STAB Drill Peck cleanly dispatches Scizor/Cacturne, while Roost provides sustained recovery.
486 BST speed sweeper. STAB Discharge electrocutes Skarmory/Dodrio and Magnezone/Blastoise for massive damage. STAB Earthquake crushes Mawile/Rhydon before it can use Magnet Rise.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 75. Water Absorb completely negates opposing water attacks. STAB Ice Beam lands catastrophic 4x super-effective damage to delete Altaria/Steelix.
479 BST Intimidate bruiser. Blunts Jasmine's physical Attack on entry. STAB Close Combat lands 4x super-effective devastation on Mawile/Rhydon. Glare inflicts 100% paralysis.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Immune to Earthquake via Levitate. Sets Calm Mind and fires powerful special attacks while completely ignoring opposing ground assaults.
Colossal 160 HP route sponge holding Leftovers. RestTalk loop absorbs wild status and damage across Kin Island and Berry Forest while resting in reserve during the 5v5 Gym duel.

flex_bench.rationale: High-durability Grass/Poison tank packing Leech Seed and Sleep Powder for status control against wild encounters.
Intimidate physical pivot and Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail for Water STAB coverage.
Technician-boosted Triple Kick and Rapid Spin for tactical versatility across route encounters.
